name: Even At My Worst Tee
note:
A white oversized tee with a compact red front graphic and a plain back. The small-scale lettering adds a sharp accent to the relaxed silhouette. Wear it with dark denim or loose trousers.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
